name: SamLax School Furniture Sales
subject: Something new at Samlax
preheader: A short update, and an easy way to opt out.

blocks.text:
{FirstName} {LastName},

My name is Sam Lax, from Sam Lax Used Furniture, a New York City Department of Education licensed vendor.

We specialize in used school furniture. Cafeteria Tables, combo desks, standalone desks/chairs, from preschool to adult sized. All of which are competitively priced and available for immediate delivery anywhere in NYC.

Our mission goes beyond savings. By giving quality furniture a second life, we help schools reduce waste and support a more sustainable city.

If your school could use additional or replacement furniture, look no further.
Everything is live now. If you would rather not hear from us again, the unsubscribe link below works immediately.
